items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Floyd Smith. That’s who you were trying to remember. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, yes. Thank you.

ctx.x: . . . no Motown, no rhythm-and-blues. That Fender bass did it, because the electric guitar, which Paul Allen has in EMP [Experience Music Project], his big museum in Seattle that [Frank] Gehry did, the evolution of the guitar, which started in 1939 with all those guys – the guy with . . .
[Jimmie] Lunceford and Charlie Christian and all that stuff. Some guy that . . . Anyway, when those two babies met . . .
